== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Snowtrooper (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Snowtrooper (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 24 March 2016). The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>a9ced1188b66c6aac727731c78b847d1bf0b234a</code>.
